records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable sales increased 19.5% for the quarter, with increases across all of our customer channels.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We also are pleased with our improved inventory position at the end of the first quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our gross margin rate for the first quarter of fiscal 2022 improved by 440 basis points driven by our brand repositioning that resulted in fewer and less frequent merchandise promotions, less penetration in lower margin wholesale revenues, and improved leverage on occupancy costs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically, and consistent with the retail industry, we have experienced seasonal fluctuations as it relates to our operating income and net income.
